title: Sexual Heroes
author: Robert Black
description: Robert Black informs, inspires, and entertains gay, bisexual, solosexual, and pansexual men through interviews with authors, musicians, researchers, adult entertainers, spiritual guides, healthcare professionals, and many others. Robert is a Grabby award winner and GayVN award nominee who has been an adult entertainer since 1998. He has a master's in adult learning, bachelor's in nursing, and certificates in various modalities of massage. In addition to this podcast, his Substack features non-fiction and semi-autobiographical erotica. All his links can be found at RobertBlack.ONE
